properties.name: spring.grpc.server.address
properties.description: Network address to which the gRPC server should bind.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable gRPC server auto-configuration.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.factory.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable gRPC server factory bean auto-configuration.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.enabled
properties.description: Whether to auto-configure the Health feature on the gRPC server.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.include-overall-health
properties.description: Whether to include the overall server health.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.schedule.delay
properties.description: Initial delay before updating the health status the very first time. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.schedule.enabled
properties.description: Whether to schedule updates to gRPC server health based on application health.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.schedule.period
properties.description: How often to update the health status. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.service
properties.description: Service-specific health reporting.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.services.validate-membership
properties.description: Whether to validate health membership for services on startup. Validation fails if a service includes or excludes a health contributor that does not exist.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.status.mapping
properties.description: Mapping of health statuses to gRPC service status. By default, registered health statuses map to sensible defaults (for example, UP maps to SERVING).

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.health.status.order
properties.description: List of health statuses in order of severity.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.inbound.message.max-size
properties.description: Maximum message size allowed to be received by the server. If a data size suffix is not specified, bytes will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.inbound.metadata.max-size
properties.description: Maximum metadata size allowed to be received by the server. If a data size suffix is not specified, bytes will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.inprocess.name
properties.description: Name of the in-process server or null to not start the in-process server.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.keepalive.connection.grace-period
properties.description: Maximum time for graceful connection termination. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.keepalive.connection.max-age
properties.description: Maximum time a connection may exist before being gracefully terminated (infinite if not specified). If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.keepalive.connection.max-idle-time
properties.description: Maximum time a connection can remain idle before being gracefully terminated (infinite if not specified). If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.keepalive.permit.time
properties.description: Maximum keep-alive time clients are permitted to configure. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.keepalive.permit.without-calls
properties.description: Whether clients are permitted to send keep alive pings when there are no outstanding RPCs on the connection.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.keepalive.time
properties.description: Duration without read activity before sending a keep alive ping. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.keepalive.timeout
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for read activity after sending a keep alive ping. If the sender does not receive an acknowledgment within this time, it will close the connection. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.netty.domain-socket-path
properties.description: Path of the domain socket that should be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.netty.transport
properties.description: Transport mechanism used for Netty and Netty Shaded servers. If not specified, the appropriate transport will be picked based on the 'domain-socket-path' or 'address/port'.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.observation.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Observations on the server.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.port
properties.description: Port on which the gRPC server should listen. Use '0' to bind to a dynamic port.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.reflection.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Reflection on the gRPC server.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.security.csrf.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable CSRF protection.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.servlet.enabled
properties.description: Whether to use a servlet server in a servlet-based web application. When the value is false, a native gRPC server will be created as long as one is available, and it will listen on its own port. Should only be needed if the GrpcServlet is on the classpath.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.servlet.validate-http2
properties.description: Whether to validate that HTTP/2 is enabled. Validation may need to be skipped if your servlet container is not configured using properties.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.shutdown.grace-period
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for the server to gracefully shutdown. When the value is negative, the server waits forever. When the value is 0, the server will force shutdown immediately. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.ssl.bundle
properties.description: SSL bundle name.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.ssl.client-auth
properties.description: Client authentication mode.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable SSL support.

properties.name: spring.grpc.server.ssl.secure
properties.description: Whether client authentication is secure (that is certificates are checked). Do not set this to false in production.
